# apipbx_queue (Resource)

A call queue. Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `number` (String) Dialable; shares the number space with extensions and ring groups.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `agent_timeout` (Number) Seconds to ring one agent (1-300).
- `announce_frequency` (Number) Seconds between announcements; needed when a position or hold time is announced.
- `announce_hold_time` (Boolean)
- `announce_position` (Boolean)
- `join_empty` (Boolean) Callers may join when no agent can take the call.
- `leave_when_empty` (Boolean) Waiting callers leave when the last able agent goes.
- `max_callers` (Number) Callers allowed to wait at once; 0 is no limit.
- `max_wait` (Number) Seconds a caller may wait; 0 is for ever.
- `members` (Attributes List) Agents. Use PJSIP extensions: IAX2 phones report no device state, so queues do not ring them reliably. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `music_on_hold` (String) A music on hold class: one of the tenant's own (apipbx_moh_class) or one Asterisk has itself, like default.
- `retry` (Number) Seconds before the agents are tried again (0-300).
- `strategy` (String) ringall, leastrecent, fewestcalls, random, rrmemory, rrordered, linear or wrandom.
- `timeout_id` (String)
- `timeout_type` (String) Where callers go who wait too long or cannot join: extension, ring_group, voicemail, time_condition, ivr, queue, conference, announcement, misc_destination, set_caller_id, paging_group, voicemail_group, disa or hangup.
- `wrapup_time` (Number) Seconds an agent rests after a call.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Required:

- `extension_id` (String)

Optional:

- `dynamic` (Boolean) Only in the queue while its owner is logged in (*45).
- `penalty` (Number) 0-1000; lower is tried first.
